preconditions.description: The number of rows n and columns m must be between 3 and 30 inclusive.
The number of copies k must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(pictures) == k + 1 and all(len(picture) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in picture) for picture in pictures)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly k+1 pictures, each with n rows and m columns.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be the index of the initial picture.
The second line of output must be the number of operations q.

postconditions.expression: all(any(op.startswith('1') for op in operations) or any(op.startswith('2') for op in operations) for operations in stdout.splitlines()[2:])
postconditions.description: Each operation must be either a recolor operation or a copy operation.
